src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_cd116_500k
cd.vint: The Census Bureau's lines of the 116th Congress's districts (its file says session 116). The Bureau published no file of the 117th Congress's districts, the Congress the 2020 election chose.
rec: Oklahoma Congressional Redistricting Act of 2011 (H.B. 1527): five districts
Oklahoma Legislature: H.B. 1527 (2011) enrolled, 'Oklahoma Congressional Redistricting Act of 2011'

Passed 2011-05-04, signed 2011-05-10 (dates from the Legislative Lines Library summary; the enrolled act was read). Census file: the Bureau's user note says its products hold the 116th Congress and the 2018 election-year legislative lines and none of the later changes; the cached cb_2020 files carry CDSESSN 116 / LSY 2018. Cached files: cb_2020 cd116 shares 1 of 5 shapes with cb_2022 (the 2021 act redrew four of the five).

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_sldu_500k
sldu.vint: The Census Bureau's 2020 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2018 legislative session year. The Bureau published no file of the lines in use for 2020. Where a state's lines changed in between, the check below or the plan cited stops the map.
rec: State Senate Redistricting Act of 2011 (S.B. 821): 48 districts
Oklahoma Legislature: S.B. 821 (2011) enrolled, 'State Senate Redistricting Act of 2011'

Passed 2011-05-16/17, signed 2011-05-20 (secondary summary; enrolled act read); the Oklahoma Supreme Court upheld it (Wilson v. Fallin, 2011-09-01). Half the Senate is elected in each even year. Census file: the Bureau's user note says its products hold the 116th Congress and the 2018 election-year legislative lines and none of the later changes; the cached cb_2020 files carry CDSESSN 116 / LSY 2018.
